messages:
maya: quick check — trying to onboard mistralx-7b-v1. Running the config lint and hit two things: the schema lint flags an unknown field `context_len`, and our assets check is complaining that the weights uri in the manifest (gs://redwood-onboard/mistralx-7b/v1/weights.tar) doesn't match the `weights_path` in the model metadata. also noticed tokenizer is tokenizing newlines differently vs our ref tokenizer (offset shift). anyone seen this combo?

 tj: yup — sounds like a schema alias mismatch. we deprecated `context_len` in favor of `max_sequence_length` last quarter. the gatekeeper/validator should accept aliases but the deployable linter version on the CI image is still the old binary. did you run `tools/config-lint --schema-ref=main` or the local one?

 maya: running the lint from the onboarding CI image (image tag onboard:v2026-03-01). command used: `./tools/config-lint --file config.json`. error dump: `unknown field: context_len` — not showing alias suggestions.

 liam: quick workaround if you need to unblock: add `max_sequence_length` set to same value and keep `context_len` (the runtime ignores unknowns, but the linter is stricter). i'll open a tiny PR to update the CI image to the latest linter. prefer a real alias fix in the schema though.

 caroline: on the weights mismatch: our asset manifest check compares `assets.weights_uri` in config.json to the `weights_path` stored in the checkpoint metadata. common cause is that the onboarding job used a gsutil-signed URL for upload then replaced it with a stable gs:// path later. which value is in your config.json right now?

 maya: config.json currently has `assets.weights_uri: "https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-onboard/.../weights.tar?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256..."` — i pushed that while waiting for a final stable path.

 infra-bot: storage-bot: quick-check result for provided URI: gs://redwood-onboard/mistralx-7b/v1/weights.tar exists, size=24.1GB, crc32c matches known-good. (registered by upload-job-87)

 tj: ok — two things then: replace signed URL with canonical gs:// path in config and re-run the asset manifest check; and for the schema, either rename the field or update the linter. liam — can you target the onboard CI image patch?

 liam: on it. will push onboard:v2026-03-02 with the updated linter and a tiny alias mapping to accept `context_len` -> `max_sequence_length`. hoping that keeps backward compat while we deprecate.

 maya: tokenizer note — i ran a small smoke tokenization test and saw that newlines are being emitted as separate tokens in our tokenizer.json (added_tokens includes "\n" at id 50256). the serving runtime expects newline to be part of whitespace normalization and keeps offsets contiguous. result: downstream evals show off-by-one on substr spans. any recommended convert steps?

 paul: we have a converter script: `tools/tokenizer-convert --from hf --to redwood --preserve-offsets`. it normalizes special tokens and will move `added_tokens` entries into `special_tokens_map` which preserves offset semantics. run it and diff tokens with `tools/tokenizer-diff`.

 maya: thanks paul — i'll run that. after i switch the weights uri and run the convert + linter (with new CI image), can someone do a quick smoke serve? i'm short on cycles today.

 tj: I can smoke it after liam's image lands. leave a comment with the final config.json link and i'll kick the smoke test: `curl -sS -X POST https://onboard-runner.internal/v1/smoke -d '{"model":"mistralx-7b-v1","input":"hello\nworld"}'` and share the logs.

 caroline: also add a quick path check in the PR description so the manifest bot can re-run the asset check automatically. :thumbsup:

 maya: will do — updating config now, will ping with links. thanks y'all.

 (reaction summary: :thumbsup: by tj, liam, caroline)
